candidates.reason: Elixir's compact module/name/arity capture is a precedent for referencing a callable with explicit identity information and no forwarding closure or parameter-type annotation.
candidates.application_scope: Syntax design for first-class function references; translating the additional identity field from arity to Swift argument labels is an inference.
candidates.constraints_or_caveat: Arity alone cannot distinguish Swift overloads with equal argument counts and different labels; label-aware resolution and any Objective-C runtime conversion would still need a separate design.

raw_response:
# C27 — Baseline B candidate answer

I found one verified transferable mechanism within the catalogue-only discovery budget.

1. **Elixir named function capture with explicit arity**  
   Verification URL: https://elixir.hexdocs.pm/main/Enum.html  
   Elixir's compact module/name/arity capture is a precedent for referencing a callable with explicit identity information and no forwarding closure or parameter-type annotation. The official Enum examples pass a named function capture directly to a higher-order function; the linked publisher cheat sheet independently documents the capture form. Translating its extra identity field to Swift argument labels is an inference, not a claim that Elixir implements Swift's overload rules. Arity alone cannot distinguish equal-arity overloads whose labels differ, and Objective-C runtime conversion remains a separate requirement.  
   Discovery catalogue: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/h4cc/awesome-elixir/master/README.md  
   Additional verification: https://media.pragprog.com/titles/elixir/ElixirCheat.pdf  
   Date status: **unknown**. The cheat sheet says v1.2 and “Updated 1/4/2016”, without defining the date order; I cannot safely place it before or after the 2016-01-20 cutoff. The official live documentation has no publication date.

I did not retain the runtime libraries whose primary pages failed to load, or the Smalltalk selector idea whose linked book content could not be verified within the budget. Apple's opened delegation page describes a different callback mechanism and was not sufficient evidence for the selector-value requirement.

This run used 9 search queries and 25 URL-open attempts, including 10 failed attempts, and stops at the page budget. It does not claim that the candidate was deployed, proved useful, or fully solves the label-disambiguation problem. Translation was performed by GPT-6 Astra Pro in an internal separate context, not by a human or a different model.

budget.counting_method: Every web open or click URL attempt, including blocked requests and alternate renderings, counts once; find operations on already opened pages do not add URL opens.

limitations: Only the assigned rules and prefix were read for task content. An initial attempt at the shorthand cases/prefix/C27.md path failed before the actual owned prefix path was read.

Catalogue discovery used awesome-list names or an explicit awesome-list path; search engines returned some off-catalogue snippets. Relevant off-catalogue exposures are recorded and were not used as clean evidence.
Ten of the twenty-five URL-open attempts failed, including the linked original Pharo PDF; those candidate routes remained unverified and were omitted.
The one retained candidate is a transferable syntax precedent and does not itself resolve same-arity, different-label Swift overloads.
The publisher PDF's numeric date is ambiguous; unknown date status is preserved. post_decision=false with date_status=unknown does not assert pre-cutoff availability.
Gold, other runs, judgments, repository history and target proposal documents were not read. Pretraining-memory leakage is not controlled; the recognized-memory association is disclosed.
No new candidate was discovered through primary verification pages; following links on those pages served only to verify already catalogue-discovered candidates.
Search result snippets were not counted as opened evidence. No public page bodies, long quotations, personal profiles or user names were saved.
Execution ended upon reaching the 25-open-attempt budget, before the 20-minute limit.
